name: crm_report
summary: Funnel, pipeline, win/loss, and attribution reporting read-models
description: Management analytics read-models for the CRM: lead funnel conversion by source and stage, open pipeline and weighted value by stage/owner, win/loss outcomes with the dominant lost reason, and campaign/source attribution. Each record is a persisted period snapshot; pipeline value is never presented as recognized revenue and attribution is a measurement model, not proof of causation.
author: Nexa
